verified_facts.text: The Nines occupies the top nine floors of the historic Meier and Frank Building in downtown Portland.
verified_facts.excerpt: Historic in nature, contemporary in everything else, The Nines occupies the top nine floors of the historic Meier and Frank Building.

verified_facts.text: Meier & Frank established their flagship store and headquarters in Portland in 1909.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once heralded as the largest retailer west of the Mississippi, Meier & Frank established their flagship store and headquarters in Portland in 1909.

verified_facts.text: A seven-story light-filled atrium was created to showcase city views, while the building's original exterior was retained.
verified_facts.excerpt: The original exterior of the building was retained, while a seven-story light-filled atrium was created to showcase our beautiful city views.

verified_facts.text: The name The Nines pays homage to the building's roots as a beacon of 'dressed to the nines' fashion.
verified_facts.excerpt: The name “the Nines” pays homage to our roots as a beacon of “dressed to the nines” fashion.

verified_facts.text: The Nines has curated a collection of more than 400 pieces of local Oregon artwork, including sculptures, paintings and custom installations.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Nines has curated a collection of more than 400 unique pieces of local Oregon artwork, including sculptures, paintings and custom installations.

verified_facts.text: Each guest room features a one-of-a-kind monotype silkscreen created by a student at the Pacific Northwest College of Art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each guest room at The Nines features a one-of-a-kind monotype silkscreen, created by a student at the Pacific Northwest College of Art.

verified_facts.text: The lobby, restaurants and library include works by local artists such as Melody Owen, Matt McCormick and Gus Van Sant, along with a 35-foot LED chandelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: From a 35-foot LED chandelier, to abstract images of Portland, our lobby, restaurants and library are decorated with works from local artists including Melody Owen, Matt McCormick and Gus Van Sant.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature satin drapes, velvet recamiers and robin blue pillows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxuriate among satin drapes, velvet récamiers, robin blue pillows and original artwork by the students at Pacific Northwest College of Art.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Frette linens, a marble tub and local Beekind bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rest under delicate Frette linens and lower yourself into a marble tub with local Beekind bath amenities.

verified_facts.text: Suites provide electric fireplaces, Club Lounge access and views of downtown Portland.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our suites provide electric fireplaces, exclusive Club Lounge access and exceptional views of downtown Portland.

verified_facts.text: The signature Nines Suite has 9-foot ceilings and oversized windows with city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in 9-foot ceilings and oversized windows with city views.

verified_facts.text: The Meier & Frank Suite has tufted velvet chairs, a deco style chandelier and over-sized windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open and airy, our 1,536 square foot Meier & Frank Suite embodies the style of a bygone era with tufted velvet chairs, a deco style chandelier and over-sized windows.

verified_facts.text: Departure Restaurant + Lounge has two rooftop patios overlooking downtown from the top floor of the Meier & Frank building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Departure features two rooftop patios overlooking downtown from the top floor of the historic Meier & Frank building.

verified_facts.text: Urban Farmer Steakhouse focuses on local and sustainable fare in a farmhouse setting within The Nines' living room.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique restaurant is situated within The Nines' living room.

verified_facts.text: A rooftop garden shared by the restaurants features a mushroom incubator, a honey bee farm and fresh herbs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shared by Urban Farmer and Departure, our rooftop garden features a mushroom incubator, a honey bee farm and fresh herbs.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Portland near Pioneer Courthouse Square, steps from tax-free shopping at Pioneer Place.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are steps from tax-free shopping at Pioneer Place, downtown dining and cultural attractions, with convenient access to MAX Light Rail for exploring the city.
